title: Ending a Urology and Continence Supply Program at the customer's request
content:
Only the customer can end an active Urology and Continence Supply Program. Larkfield records the cancellation as a program cancellation request, and the program closes only when the customer personally confirms that request. The evidence is the cancellation request on file for this program and its confirmed status.

## Closure reason

A confirmed cancellation closes the program with the closure reason *customer discontinued*. When the customer states that they are moving these supplies to another supplier, the reason is *changed supplier*. A cancellation of a program on hold is closed under the hold and closure rules.

## What ending a program does and does not do

| Matter | Effect of ending the program |
|---|---|
| Fee for ending | none |
| Amounts already owed | nothing is cancelled: the balance stays payable |
| Credit balances | still refunded under the patient account rules |
| Unopened items delivered within the return window | still returnable under the returns terms |
| Authorized units remaining | lapse and are never shipped |
| A package already shipped | not recalled |
| A later restart | needs a new referral and a new program |
